set.head: SETTINGS
set.shortcut.text: Opens NeuralDeck from anywhere. To change it, press the button, then the new keys.
set.autostart.text: Turned on or off with the "Start NeuralDeck with Windows" option of the Neural setup.
set.theme.text: NeuralDeck follows the series theme. To change it: theme neon, theme ice, theme alarm, theme daylight.
set.lang.text: The language of every Neural app. A change shows the next time each app starts.
set.capture: Press a key together with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win. Esc to cancel.
tray.balloon: The {accel} shortcut could not be registered. Open Settings from the NeuralDeck icon in the notification area and pick another shortcut.
err.shortcut-taken: {accel} could not be registered: another program may be using this shortcut.
err.shortcut-invalid: This key combination cannot be used: pick a key together with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
